intro h
split
· intro h1
  cases h1 with h2 h3
  · exact ⟨1, by rw [h2, pow_zero]⟩
  · rcases h3 with h4 | h5
    · have := h4.1
      rw [pow_one] at this
      exact ⟨1, this⟩
    · have := h4.2
      rw [pow_one] at this
      exact ⟨1, this⟩
· intro h1
  cases h1 with h2 h3
  · have := h2.1
    rw [pow_zero] at this
    exact ⟨0, this, rfl⟩
  · have := h3.1
    have h4 : (n.nthRoot a) ^ n = a := h3.2
    exact ⟨n, h4⟩
